Moderator
Hello everyone,
Last week, on a new episode of the Team Deakins Podcast, production designer Judy Becker was the featured guest. Judy most recently worked on THE BRUTALIST, and you can also see her work on television in a number of shows created by producer Ryan Murphy.
After listening, feel free to discuss the episode with each other below!
